Damdast is an all-in-one Android toolbox built for everyday life. Every tool runs locally on your device whenever possible, with no account and no unnecessary data collection.
Damdast is free and supported by respectful advertising.

Damdast is local-first. Files you open, images you edit, text you convert, notes, tasks, favorites and history are processed and stored on your device. We do not operate an account system and we do not upload your files to a Damdast server.

Permissions are requested only when a feature needs them. Camera access is used only while you are scanning a code. File and photo access goes through Android's system pickers, so Damdast only sees the item you choose. Damdast does not request notification or background location access.

Advertising is provided by Tapsell. The Tapsell SDK may collect device and advertising identifiers, approximate network information and ad interaction data to deliver and measure ads, subject to Tapsell's privacy policy. Advertising data is not linked to your notes, files or scans by Damdast. You can review Tapsell's policy at https://tapsell.ir.

Some actions such as share, open link or send feedback hand data to the app you select. Those apps have their own privacy practices. Damdast never silently uploads a file.

You can clear recent activity at any time in Settings. Uninstalling the app removes all locally stored Damdast data.
Questions about privacy: open the project on GitHub or use the feedback entry in Settings.
